items.title: Earnings live updates: Salesforce, CrowdStrike, Okta stocks soar as AI boom helps lift Q2 results
items.summary: The second quarter earnings season is nearly complete. Nvidia's Q2 results on Wednesday served as a keystone to a remarkably strong stretch of corporate reports.

items.title: AI Winner or Victim? Inside Salesforce's Q2 earnings
items.summary: RBC Capital Markets managing director Rishi Jaluria joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to assess Salesforce's (CRM) latest earnings reporting, which shows profits beating expectations. Jaluria highlights how Salesforce is addressing AI's impact on the software industry and the effectiveness of its latest acquisitions.

items.title: Salesforce stock surges on Q2 earnings: 'One of our best quarters ever,' CEO Marc Benioff says
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) reported second quarter results on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $5.90, while revenue came in at $11.35 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $11.32 billion). Third quarter revenue guidance came in at $11.42–11.5 billion. Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the breaking numbers.

items.title: Nvidia, Micron, Salesforce, Marvell, Veeva, Okta, Hormel, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks rallied Thursday as a batch of stellar earnings reports, including one from Nvidia revived Wall Street’s appetite for tech stocks.  Nvidia shares rose 8.6% after the chip maker’s second-quarter earnings topped analysts’ expectations.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Leads Gains As Nvidia Crosses New Buy Point, Gold Miners Mixed (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite was the best-performing among major indexes Thursday as Wall Street reacted to big earnings reports, with Nvidia, Salesforce and CrowdStrike soaring on the stock market today.  Nvidia broke out past a proper buy point.  The Dow industrials rose 200 points, or nearly 0.4%, led by its tech components including Nvidia and Salesforce.
